children: StablecoinX entered into a Waiver Letter with Ethena OpCo and the Ethena Foundation to permanently remove all lock-up, vesting and unlocking restrictions on ENA tokens held by or deliverable to the company, effective Oct 5, 2026. The agreement also creates a framework for funding sales of ENA, requiring five business days' notice during which the Foundation may purchase some or all tokens at the proposed price. Any ENA dispositions still require the Foundation's prior written consent under the existing Collaboration Agreement and remain subject to applicable laws.
: Waiver Letter and token sale framework
: Enhance liquidity and align token sales with Ethena ecosystem goals
